action: No security action is needed; Microsoft says this was not an attack. Microsoft 365 customers: confirm that delayed email has arrived, check for service credits under your agreement and review how staff communicate when email is down.
exec: About a day and a half without email and collaboration tools shows the dependence on one cloud supplier; the company rules out an attack.
impact: Email and collaboration tools were unavailable for many organizations for roughly a day and a half.
plain: A fault in Microsoft's email servers on November 12 took down Outlook and slowed Teams, Copilot and other services around the world, with recovery running into November 14. Microsoft says a network upgrade caused it, not an attack.
summary: Exchange Online servers failed health checks on November 12, taking down Outlook and degrading Teams, Copilot and other services worldwide. Downdetector logged nearly 130,000 Outlook reports at the peak and recovery ran into November 14. Microsoft blames a fault introduced by an earlier network capacity upgrade and says it was not a cyberattack. Cyber cause: ruled out by the company.
title: Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams and Copilot in more than 70 countries

validation.note: Company statements reported consistently by several outlets.
